note: Hand-authored, not generated. Both scripts/sync.mjs and the site read this file, so a code can never mean two things. Each entry maps the single-character code used in the emitted records to the archive's own wording for it. `yarn sync` fails when it meets a wording that is not here, which is how a new verdict in the archive is caught rather than silently dropped.

writeClass.U: unchanging, so a clamp and a refusal cannot be told apart

holdVerdict.D: every address answered differently from its neighbours
holdVerdict.I: some neighbouring addresses could not be told apart
holdVerdict.A: only one address here would answer, so there was nothing to compare it with

audibleVerdict.N: not audible under what was tried

resetOutcome.-: not marked, so this reset was not asked about it

efxParamVerdict.N: not audible under the note asked
efxParamVerdict.M: started something that does not repeat
efxParamVerdict.X: no yardstick under the note asked, so not asked
